skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply accounting principles and practices in public sector organizations.
Analyze financial statements and reports of public sector organizations.
Manage budgets and financial resources in public sector organizations.
Prepare and present financial reports and statements.
Evaluate and critique accounting policies and practices in public sector organizations.
Work effectively in teams and communicate financial information in an international context.
Coordinate and manage resources in public sector organizations.
Understand and apply ethical standards in public accounting.
Develop a habit of lifelong learning in the field of public accounting.
